title: Evaluating Near-Perfect Accuracy Claims in Machine-Learning-Based Leak Detection for Two-Phase Pipelines: A Condition-Blocked Audit
abstract: arXiv:2611.19965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable leak detection in gas-liquid two-phase pipelines is important for process safety, yet machine-learning studies frequently report near-perfect performance using evaluation protocols that may not represent deployment to unseen operating conditions. This study audits a pressure-based leak-detection model using condition-blocked leave-one-condition-out validation, in which the classifier is tested on a flow condition excluded from training. Accuracy decreased from 93.3% under within-condition evaluation to 59.1% across fifteen unseen-condition tests. Ablation analysis showed that most of this difference arose from the data-splitting protocol, with a smaller contribution from encoding operating conditions as model inputs. Under condition-blocked evaluation, the false-alarm and missed-detection rates increased to 34.1% and 10.2%, respectively, demonstrating that near-perfect reported accuracy did not translate into reliable operation

translated_title: 评估基于机器学习的两相管道泄漏检测中近乎完美的准确率声明：一项条件阻断式审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.19965v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：气液两相管道的可靠泄漏检测对工艺安全至关重要，然而机器学习研究经常使用可能无法代表部署到未见运行工况的评估协议来报告近乎完美的性能。本研究采用条件阻断的留一工况验证法对基于压力的泄漏检测模型进行了审计，其中分类器在训练中排除的流动工况上进行测试。准确率从工况内评估下的93.3%下降到十五次未见工况测试中的59.1%。消融分析表明，这一差异大部分源于数据划分协议，而将运行工况编码为模型输入的贡献较小。在条件阻断评估下，误报率和漏检率分别上升至34.1%和10.2%，表明近乎完美的报告准确率并不能转化为可靠的运行表现。
tldr: 本研究通过条件阻断式留一工况验证审计发现，两相管道机器学习泄漏检测模型报告的93.3%近乎完美准确率在未见工况下骤降至59.1%，误报率与漏检率大幅上升，揭示了传统评估协议严重高估了模型的实际部署性能。
en_tdlr: A condition-blocked leave-one-condition-out audit reveals that a machine-learning leak detection model for two-phase pipelines claiming 93.3% accuracy drops to 59.1% on unseen operating conditions, demonstrating that standard within-condition evaluation protocols substantially overestimate real-world deployment performance.
